title: Most Champions League titles
brief: Name the ten players who have won the Champions League the most times since 1992/93. A title counts if the player played in that season's competition for the winning club.
period: Champions League winners 1993 to 2026; titles before 1992/93 not counted

notes.Isco: Isco played in four winning campaigns; he was in the 2021/22 squad but played no Champions League games that season.
notes.Samuel Eto'o: Samuel Eto'o has four, counting 1999/2000 when he played for Real Madrid before leaving.
notes.Paolo Maldini: Paolo Maldini has three since 1992/93 (five counting 1989 and 1990).

checks: Titles counted where the player made at least one Champions League appearance for the winning club that season, checked two ways: UEFA.com season appearances by club and Transfermarkt game logs; both give the same counts for every player here. Wikipedia lists the same four on six and the same six Real Madrid players on five, but gives Seedorf four (it leaves out 1999/2000, when he played for Real Madrid until January). Transfermarkt honours pages give Seedorf five and also give Isco five (squad member in 2021/22 with no appearances). Seven players have five, so any six of them fill places five to ten.
